stories.title: CISA flags WordPress RCE flaw as actively exploited in attacks
stories.summary: The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warned federal agencies that attackers have started exploiting a recently patched high-severity WordPress vulnerability in the wild.

stories.title: Zyxel GS1900 Patch Fails to Block Zero-Day Exploit Allowing Root Command Execution
stories.summary: Zyxel GS1900 network switches that received the vendor's earlier fix for an actively exploited flaw are still open to the exploit attackers used, researchers at Binarly found. The exploit lets anyone who can reach a switch's web management interface run commands on it without logging in. Zyxel has released new firmware for 10 GS1900 models that closes the hole. stories.title: CERT-In Flags AI-Driven Attacks as Backdoored ARTEX Exposes 62 Consoles to Root Access
stories.summary: The Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) has disclosed that an artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted threat actor it tracks as Crafty Falcon is targeting organizations in the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) sectors in the country. Describing the threat as active and ongoing, the activity involves the use of publicly-available AI-driven offensive security tools

stories.title: APT29-Linked Hackers Hijack Web Analytics Script to Deliver iOS and Android Exploits
stories.summary: The Russia-linked threat actor known as APT29 is presumed to be behind a large-scale watering hole campaign targeting iOS and Android users through compromised websites, fake domains, and a supply chain attack involving a Ukrainian web analytics service called Plerdy SEO Tracker. stories.title: 5 Active Cyber Threats That Put US Enterprises at Risk in October 2026
stories.summary: October 2026 brought another wave of cyber threats targeting US businesses, with attackers exploiting trusted platforms, legitimate authentication processes, and everyday business workflows. stories.title: Zyxel Switch Hacks Blamed on Patched Flaw Actually Exploited a Zero-Day
stories.summary: Tracked as CVE-2026-107441, the out-of-bounds write flaw could allow attackers to execute OS commands via crafted HTTP requests.

stories.title: Zyxel fixes zero-day exploited to hack nearly 1,000 network switches
stories.summary: Zyxel has patched a zero-day vulnerability in its GS1900 series network switches that hackers exploited to compromise nearly 1,000 devices worldwide and steal configuration files and credentials.

stories.title: Vercel rolls out new protection against stolen session cookie attacks
stories.summary: Vercel is gradually rolling out Device Bound Session Credentials (DBSC) on its platform as a key defense against information stealer malware.
